description: Simulate a call stack with string frame names, demonstrating function call and return via push and pop.
code:
from manim import *
from manim_dsa import MStack, MStackStyle

class MStackCallStack(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        stack = (
            MStack(["main"], style=MStackStyle.BLUE)
            .add_label(Text("Call Stack", font_size=24))
            .to_edge(RIGHT)
        )
        self.play(Create(stack))
        self.wait(0.2)
        self.play(stack.animate.append("foo"))
        self.wait(0.2)
        self.play(stack.animate.append("bar"))
        self.wait(0.2)
        self.play(stack.animate.pop())
        self.wait(0.2)
        self.play(stack.animate.pop())
        self.wait(0.3)
